description: This module allows to manage user groups on a univention corporate server (UCS). It uses the Python API of the UCS to create a new object or edit it.

parameters.name: ou
parameters.description: LDAP OU, for example school for LDAP OU ou=school,dc=example,dc=com. Default: ""

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Define the whole LDAP position of the group, for example cn=g123m-1A,cn=classes,cn=schueler,cn=groups,ou=schule,dc=example,dc=com. Default: ""

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the group is present or not. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: subpath
parameters.description: Subpath inside the OU, for example cn=classes,cn=students,cn=groups. Default: "cn=groups"

examples:
- name: Create a POSIX group
  community.general.udm_group:
    name: g123m-1A

# Create a POSIX group with the exact DN
# C(cn=g123m-1A,cn=classes,cn=students,cn=groups,ou=school,dc=school,dc=example,dc=com)
- name: Create a POSIX group with a DN
  community.general.udm_group:
    name: g123m-1A
    subpath: 'cn=classes,cn=students,cn=groups'
    ou: school

# or
- name: Create a POSIX group with a DN
  community.general.udm_group:
    name: g123m-1A
    position: 'cn=classes,cn=students,cn=groups,ou=school,dc=school,dc=example,dc=com'
